correctness.rationale: Each orthogonal projection after an exceptional first row multiplies squared error by k exactly when the projected line switches. RR has one switch conditional on starting exceptionally, and IID has generating polynomial G_m=(1,0)T_m(k)^(m-1)(1,1)^T. The difference has a strict unique root because G_m-k is strictly convex, starts positive and has positive derivative at one for at least three rows. Exact zero- and one-switch coefficients imply the root asymptotic; isolated rare exceptions imply the Poisson risk-ratio limit. Exact-rational projection enumeration verifies up to six rows and the pairwise distinct-row witness; finite verification is not the infinite proof. The m=2 boundary and k endpoints are expressly separated.

originality.rationale: The reviewed survey and RRK paper compare empirical performance or convergence bounds, not the exact one-epoch, fixed-initial-direction RR-vs-IID risk law for all-but-one repeated rows. General IID exact-MSE work does not give the RR permutation word law, unique angular thresholds or superexponential multiplicity transition. The 2026 broad SGD paper gives averaged-iterate rate guarantees at substantially smaller steps, not strict pointwise endpoint risk dominance for full Kaczmarz projections. The related two-row and stationary scalar comparisons do not imply this at least three rows theorem. Novelty is a best-knowledge scientific judgment, with explicit specialized-literature priority risk.
residual_risks: An older specialized finite-epoch comparison of redundant Kaczmarz rows may already state a switch-count formula or equivalent threshold.

value.rationale: Random reshuffling is frequently preferred for Kaczmarz because it forces row coverage. The theorem identifies an exact finite-epoch initial-error regime in which coverage is worse, at every redundant-row multiplicity at least three rows, with a unique cosine-squared threshold, an asymptotically superexponentially tiny boundary, and a limiting excess error ratio reaching e. This is a motivated structural classification of a natural measurement-redundancy mechanism, rather than an isolated arbitrary numerical sign check; the all-distinct rational witness establishes robustness while the stated limits avoid unwarranted generalization.
